leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the nuclei felt somewhat repetitive after making them, although the result usefully explained how copies of instructions reach the protein-building machinery.

arbitrary.text: None felt especially arbitrary: the named slots and compatible choices gave each action a clear purpose, though they also made several decisions predictable.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter to see how these muscle cells become tissue and contribute to movement. The explanations made the parts’ roles clear, though I hope the later choices offer more to figure out.
